verdict.rationale: Penpot is a design tool, so professional vector editing is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions a pen tool, path editing, boolean operations or alignment controls. General statements about designing interfaces, prototyping and components describe other features, not the vector toolset this story asks about.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work
